segments.title: Part 1: Original

tenBlocks.block3_goal: A six-shot, thirty-second segment inside a short family animated comedy. Ordinary afternoon card battle; Shaz declares himself a scientist twice, the third time Mom believes him. Six shots. It ends the instant @Mom's line finishes — do not continue, do not resolve anything, do not add an ending. The comedy is played completely straight. Nobody in frame knows anything is funny.
tenBlocks.block6_visualStyle: Feature-quality 3D animated film, production CG, not photorealistic and not flat cartoon. Warm late-afternoon window light, soft subsurface glow through ears and skin, tactile materials. Depth of field as a natural in-camera optical artifact.
tenBlocks.block7_cameraAndPerformance: Six shots separated by five hard cuts. The body plays broad. The face stays honest. No mugging, no pulled faces, no comic reactions. Anticipation: every move winds the opposite way first. Snap and settle with overshoot on arrival. Moving holds: held poses breathe and micro-shift. Overlap and secondary action: hijab fabric and sleeves arrive a beat late. Eye life: micro-saccades, live catchlights, realistic blinks.
tenBlocks.block8_audio: <card slap> <fridge hum> <kettle starts to whistle> Quiet kitchen room tone; a soft comedic pizzicato accent on the final hold.
tenBlocks.block9_exclusions: The only spoken words in the entire segment are the lines in braces. Nothing else written anywhere in this prompt is dialogue, and nobody speaks who is not named on a line. No extra cuts anywhere. No unison movement. No subtitles, no watermark, no logo.
tenBlocks.block10_maintainConsistency: 3 characters: @Shaz, @Mom, @Sister. @Shaz is 4.5 heads tall (long torso, short legs); adults are 7 heads tall. @Shaz screen-left, @Sister screen-right; this never flips.

shots.action: Wide shot of the kitchen table; Shaz slaps a card down across from his sister.
Medium on Shaz lowering his sunglasses very slowly.
Close-up on Sister, unimpressed, one slow blink.
Medium on Shaz pushing sunglasses up and slapping a second card.
Mom appears in the doorway holding a tea towel, watching.
Close-up on Mom: she nods seriously, holding back a smile, breathing.
